attributes.name: Spellcharger Jerkin
attributes.powers:
Recharge this card to reduce Acid, Combat, or Electricity damage dealt to you by 2.

Recharge this card to add 1d4 to your check to recharge a spell.

Banish this card to reduce Combat damage dealt to you to 0.

If you are proficient with light armors, banish this card to reduce Acid or Electricity damage dealt to you to 0.
